name: ls-global-assembleias
description: LS Global Assembleias — plataforma SaaS multi-tenant para assembleias presenciais, virtuais e híbridas

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lsg/shared && npm run build -w @lsg/api && npm run build -w @lsg/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @lsg/api && npm run typecheck -w @lsg/web
scripts.setup: npm run build:shared && npm run db:setup && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lsg/api" "npm run dev -w @lsg/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @lsg/shared && npm run test -w @lsg/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @lsg/api
